# Required pre-writing page brief

Complete this before creating or changing customer-facing page content. Keep the brief in the current task review records or a sanitised repository development record; never include private customer data.

- Page route, audience, purpose and current implementation commit:
- Reference version and source inventory checked (including newer actual approved Sources):
- Applicable rule IDs / exact filenames, dates, approval status, decision references:
- Service description and eligibility:
- Service experience, design source and priority journey (independent axes):
- Quotation, acceptance, payment and production-start conditions:
- Delivery / collection / storage arrangements and exceptions:
- Communication channels, schedules and distinct confirmation/response targets:
- Applicable Terms, Refund, Privacy, measurements/fabric guidance:
- Approved benefits, eligibility and unresolved conditions:
- Verified official contact configuration and what delivery has actually been tested:
- Button contract for EACH visible action: source page, destination, context passed, expected result, failure behaviour, mobile behaviour, readiness:
- Forms: necessary fields, validation, privacy/spam protection, genuine backend, review, duplicate/error handling, success evidence:
- SEO: unique title/description/H1/canonical, internal links/schema/indexing/sitemap decision:
- Missing / proposed / contradictory / unverified rules and unresolved-register entries:
- Homepage/shared-component impact and required approval:
- Safe independent implementation scope, held publication changes and required owner review:
- Actual tests and screenshot evidence; distinguish previous results from current tests:

Do not ask the owner to repeat an available approved fact. Do not fill a missing clause by analogy with another service. Continue safe work while recording a precisely scoped dependency.
